items.title: Tradeoffs Between Usability and Security (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Tradeoffs Between Usability and Security' (PDF 21): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Tradeoff ka matlab hai ek cheez barhao to doosri ghat jati hai. Security barhane se systems use karna mushkil ho sakta hai. Strong (mazboot) passwords yaad rakhna mushkil hai. Extra (izafi) login steps users ko slow kar dete hain. Simple (saade) systems aasan magar kam secure hote hain. Security hatane se risk (khatra) barhta hai. Safe (mehfooz) aur aasan use ke liye dono mein balance (tawazun) zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Misaal ke taur par password manager ya fingerprint se login mazboot security rakhte hue bhi user ke liye kaam aasan bana dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Aik misaal dein jahan izafi security system ko use karna mushkil banati hai, aur us mushkil ko kam karne ka aik tareeqa.
blocks.explanation: Misaal: bank app jo har dafa password aur one-time code maangti hai, kholne mein zyada waqt leti hai. Fingerprint ya chehre se login kam qadmon mein bhi app ko mehfooz rakhta hai.

items: Zyada security = aksar kam aasani (mushkil passwords, izafi login steps); kam security = zyada khatra; dono mein balance.
